questions: Should the function set a specific language for the Wikipedia library (e.g., wikipedia.set_lang) or rely on the default/global language setting?
What should be done if the Wikipedia page exists but the content is empty or very short (e.g., a stub)?
Should the word cloud use default WordCloud parameters (as in reference) or custom ones (e.g., stopwords, max_words, background_color)?
Is the function expected to close or show the matplotlib figure, or leave it open for further manipulation?
Should the function handle Wikipedia disambiguation pages or redirects automatically, or treat them as errors?
What specific exception(s) should be caught to determine 'no Wikipedia page with the title'? (e.g., wikipedia.exceptions.PageError, DisambiguationError, any Exception?)
Should the function preprocess the Wikipedia content (e.g., remove markup, section headers, references) beyond what the library provides?
Is the function required to work for Wikipedia page titles that include special characters or non-ASCII characters?
